verdicts.reason: The two candidates are nearly identical banners, and both are clearly broken. Each crams the full 4-line headline, the body paragraph, a 'Ships late June' note wrapped into a 3-word column, and a block of fine print into one strip. The SOLSTICE wordmark is jammed against the bottom of a small dark logo panel, and 'Limited Summer Release' is stranded below it. The Reserve a Case button is a small pill in the top-right corner, so the CTA is buried. The legal text is illegibly tiny, packed against the right edge and almost as heavy as the body copy. There is no left-to-right hierarchy, just a shrunk copy of the original. The small differences in button and text positions don't make either one better.
